facts.fact: Launch Base Africa reports the BCEAO runs PI-SPI, the shared instant payment platform through which interoperable e-money transfers have had to route since 2 November 2026, covering Cote d'Ivoire.
Launch Base Africa reports the BCEAO runs PI-SPI, the shared instant payment platform through which interoperable e-money transfers have had to route since 2 November 2026, covering Senegal.

Launch Base Africa reports the BCEAO capped PI-SPI transfer fees to protect consumers, free under 8,000 CFA francs a day and 0.8 per cent above, in force from 2 November 2026 and applying in Cote d'Ivoire.
Launch Base Africa reports the BCEAO capped PI-SPI transfer fees to protect consumers, free under 8,000 CFA francs a day and 0.8 per cent above, in force from 2 November 2026 and applying in Senegal.
